heroDescription: Fix Septic Now provides complete septic tank cleaning in Ennis and Ellis County. Cleaning goes beyond basic pumping by removing built-up sludge, scum, and residue that can reduce tank capacity and stress your drain field. In Ennis, where blackland clay already limits drain field performance, keeping your tank clean is one of the best investments you can make. Call (469) 986-7883 to schedule service.
localRelevance:
Septic tank cleaning in Ennis is especially valuable because the local blackland clay leaves little margin for error. When a tank isn't fully cleaned, residual solids can carry over into the drain field and gradually clog the soil. In sandy soils, some contamination may disperse over time. In Ellis County clay, those solids tend to seal the soil permanently, reducing or destroying drain field function.

Our cleaning service includes complete pumping plus additional attention to tank walls, baffles, and inlet/outlet pipes. We remove accumulated scum and sludge that basic pumping can leave behind, and we inspect components for cracks, corrosion, or blockages while the tank is empty. For older Ennis systems, this level of cleaning can reveal problems early and extend the life of the drain field.

Homes with garbage disposals, large households, or tanks that haven't been serviced on schedule benefit most from full cleaning. We recommend combining cleaning with an inspection so you have a complete picture of your system's condition.

faqs.question: What's the difference between septic pumping and cleaning in Ennis?
faqs.answer: Pumping removes the liquid and most solids from the tank. Cleaning is more thorough and removes built-up residue on tank walls, baffles, and pipes. In Ennis's blackland clay, full cleaning provides better protection for your drain field.

faqs.question: How much does septic cleaning cost in Ennis?
faqs.answer: Septic tank cleaning in Ennis typically costs $350 to $700 depending on tank size, condition, and accessibility. We provide an upfront quote before starting.

faqs.question: Should I get my septic tank cleaned or pumped in Ennis?
faqs.answer: If your tank has been serviced regularly, pumping is usually enough. If it has been several years, if you notice odors or slow drains, or if you want maximum drain field protection, full cleaning is the better choice.
